title: Surreal Floating Island
description: A fantastical night scene features a central floating island platform with purple stone tiles, a glowing blue tree with intricate branches, an open ancient book, and a small turtle near a wooden plank. In the background, a giant hourglass with golden sand sits on a dark rocky outcrop covered in runes, alongside glowing purple stepping stones, a lighthouse emitting beams of light, a large full moon, and scattered maps floating in a cloudy sky.
prompt: A surreal fantasy night scene with a floating island made of purple stone tiles, a glowing bright blue magical tree with intricate branches growing from an ornate base, an open ancient book with glowing pages, and a small turtle on the edge. To the left, a giant hourglass with golden sand rests on a dark rocky cliff covered in runes, with glowing purple stepping stones leading towards it. A tall lighthouse with golden light beams shines across a cloudy sky with a large detailed full moon. Maps and rocky formations float in the misty purple atmosphere, whimsical and dreamlike digital painting style.
